Name: Bobbie - A Custom Dog Skin for Stardew Valley
Author: Npena95
Description:
Bobbie is a heartfelt tribute to mine and my bf late dog. This custom dog skin mod for Stardew Valley aims to bring the spirit of Bobbie to your farm, providing a warm, loving companion as you embark on your farming journey. Crafted with love and attention to detail, this mod captures the essence of Bobbie's appearance and demeanor, allowing you to cherish her memory while playing the game. I do kinda suck at art but I promise she was wonderful and beautiful and I hope she makes you smile.
